ABOUT OUR COMPANY

Ed Brannigan founded Brannigan Heating & Air Conditioning in 1987 out of a single truck and his garage on the north end of Springfield. Nearly forty years later the company runs eight trucks and employs fourteen people, but the approach has not changed: do good work, charge a fair price, and treat every house like it belongs to your own family.

We are fully licensed and insured in the state of Illinois, and every technician on staff carries NATE certification. We are also an accredited business with the Better Business Bureau and have held an A+ rating since 2004.
